weight_policy: original base weights, no task finetuning, no gradient or optimizer
state_encoding: end effector xyz normalized by environment hand workspace bounds; gripper opening [0,1] mapped to [-1,1]; padded to 32; discrete state prompt enabled
action_encoding: direct normalized first four model outputs interpreted as MetaWorld dx,dy,dz,gripper; clipped to action_space bounds; no learned unnormalizer
limitation: base checkpoint has no verified Sawyer/MetaWorld action decoder or normalization stats; measures base plus fixed direct adapter, not a validated native Sawyer zero-shot policy
success: first policy step with info.success true ends episode successfully
infrastructure_retry: at most one retry with identical seed; retain failed attempts, do not count as policy failures

prompts.assembly-v2: Pick up a nut and place it onto a peg
prompts.disassemble-v2: Pick a nut out of a peg
prompts.stick-pull-v2: Grasp a stick and pull a box with the stick
